protocol.isolation: One fresh Node process per run; original generator and solver; no solver edits or cache reuse. Factor 1 shares each case baseline.
protocol.moment_normalization: Sum of ||r cross F|| and ||applied nodal moment|| over external nodal loads, origin (0,0,0); floor 1 Nm.
protocol.force_normalization: Sum of norms of external nodal load vectors, floor 1 N.
protocol.classification: Pass: stated diagnostic met. Partial: explained formulation/active-state limitation or inapplicability. Fail: failed solve or unexplained numerical/mechanics inconsistency. These are study thresholds, not design acceptance standards.
